dedupe_keys.name: transformer inrush measurements in a distribution grid laboratory

description: Transformer Inrush Measurements in a Distribution Grid Laboratory is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Alexander Winkens, Florian Klein-Helmkamp (IAEW at RWTH Aachen University). This data set contains measurement data of distribution transformer inrush transients obtained in the Distribution Grid Laboratory at the IAEW at RWTH Aachen University. Within the framework of the investigations, a medium voltage feeder with one or multiple medium/low voltage transformers is energised. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
